verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a desktop operating system, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a Fedora Workstation feature for acting on many items at once. The 'single command' line describes how easily packages can be installed, not bulk operations across many items, so it is at most adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
